title: Ledger record: success_signal
description: A mechanically inspectable condition for acceptance (PRD §10.2, §10.10). Success signals are executable assertions where possible — encoded as tests or validators, not stated in prose.

data.$comment: Phase 0: payload shape is deliberately loose. `check.kind` is intentionally an open string until the check registry lands with the compiler.

mechanical.description: False means the signal is not yet machine-checkable, and says so instead of implying it is.
